sloka: नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि वनवासे विहृत्य ते ।पुनः पादौ ग्रहीष्यामि प्रतिज्ञान्ते नराधिपः ॥२-३४-२९॥
transliteration: nava pañca ca varṣāṇi vanavāse vihṛtya te ।punaḥ pādau grahīṣyāmi pratijñānte narādhipaḥ ॥2-34-29॥

translations.english: Having fulfilled the vow on the completion of fourteen years of wandering in the forest I shall come back to touch your feet, O lord of men
